cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Expand Your Jurisdiction
cards.instruction: Use every new problem as a reason to expand what you are entitled to control.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your deliveries interrupt meetings. Send the van schedule for my approval; arrivals need proper coordination.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You book the rooms. I'll send you our arrival times.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Times without routes aren't a schedule I can verify. Send both, please, and wait for my approval.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The council keeps closing the access road. We can't schedule around that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give their roads team my booking calendar. Ask them to submit closures before confirming them. Proposed dates, please, not another notice after the barriers go up.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 verified routes and A5 proposed-date correction make professional scheduling expand A claimed jurisdiction into council closures.

responseLogic.evidence: B4 unpredictable closures causally supports demand for advance proposals; A5 after-barriers notice is A complaint about late information, not necessary unseen staging.
